subject.title: Landing page: how afbd.gabocodes.com works
subject.intent: Show the landing's entry points, the language choice, the hero video that drives the titles, and what happens on clicks and scroll
subject.scope: site/ workspace (React + Vite, served by GitHub Pages)

SegmentId.desc: Which part of the hero loop is on screen: the opening question, code as logic, the caught bug, or the layers. Each one has its own title and subtitle.

MediaSources.desc: The hero's video files for one layout and language, e.g. /media/hero-wide-es.webm with an MP4 fallback, plus the poster shared by both languages.

nodes.label: Page load
nodes.desc: The browser opens the page; the app reads what it needs from the browser once.

nodes.label: Click EN / ES
nodes.desc: The visitor picks a language with the switch.

nodes.label: Click a section link
nodes.desc: The visitor follows an in-page link to a section.

nodes.label: Click GitHub
nodes.desc: The visitor follows a link to the repository.

nodes.label: Click Copy
nodes.desc: The visitor copies one of the two install commands.

nodes.label: Click play / pause
nodes.desc: The visitor stops or restarts the hero video with the round button at the bottom right.

nodes.label: Language
nodes.desc: Decides whether the page speaks English or Spanish, remembers the choice and switches it.

nodes.label: Saved language
nodes.desc: The visitor's last choice, so the page opens in it next time.

nodes.label: Pick language
nodes.desc: Chooses the first language when the page loads.
logic: A saved choice of en or es wins.
Otherwise the first browser language whose primary tag is en or es (es-CO counts as es).
Otherwise English.
Blocked storage (private window) reads as no saved choice; the page still works.

nodes.label: Set language
nodes.desc: Switches the page to the clicked language and remembers it.
logic: Tells i18next to change language, which re-renders every text.
Sets <html lang> for screen readers and search engines.
Saves the choice; if storage is blocked it is only kept for this visit.

nodes.label: Current language
nodes.desc: The language every component renders in; components re-render when it changes.
nodes.store: i18next instance · in memory, lost on reload

nodes.label: Hero video
nodes.desc: The dark first screen: a looping 37 s video behind a title that changes with what the video shows.

nodes.label: Pick layout
nodes.desc: Chooses the tall (4:5) render for portrait screens and the wide (16:9) one otherwise.
logic: Reads matchMedia('(orientation: portrait)') once, on the first render.
Portrait gives tall, so the diagram stays above the title on a phone; anything else gives wide.

nodes.label: Choose media files
nodes.desc: Builds the video and poster paths for the layout and the page's language; the speech bubbles in the video are in that language.
logic: Video: /media/hero-<layout>-<lang>.webm, then .mp4 as the fallback.
Poster: /media/hero-<layout>-poster.webp, the same for both languages (frame 0 is an empty canvas).
The <video> is keyed by language, so switching EN/ES mounts a new one that starts from 0 s.

nodes.label: Reduced motion?
nodes.desc: Starts the video by itself unless the visitor asked their system for less motion.
logic: No: mute the video (browsers only autoplay muted video) and play it.
Yes: no autoplay and no preload; the poster stays and the button offers Play.

nodes.label: Browser <video>
nodes.desc: The browser's video player, muted and looping, behind the hero. It reports the playback time and its play and pause events.

nodes.label: Segment at time
nodes.desc: Tells which part of the loop the video is in, from its current time.
logic: Runs on every timeupdate event (about 4 times a second).
Takes the time modulo the 37 s loop.
Picks the last segment that started: intro 0 s, b 3 s, a 15 s, c 26 s.
A bad time (NaN, negative) gives the intro.

nodes.label: Current segment
nodes.desc: The segment whose title is on screen.
nodes.store: React state in useHeroVideo · lost on reload

nodes.label: Intro hold
nodes.desc: Keeps the opening question on screen longer: the video stands still for 5 s on the code, just before it turns into blocks.

nodes.label: Reached the hold point?
nodes.desc: Pauses the video when playback crosses 2.2 s, once per loop.
logic: Checks every video frame (requestVideoFrameCallback) and every timeupdate, so it stops right on 2.2 s.
Holds only when the time moved from before 2.2 s to less than 0.5 s past it: a seek further on doesn't hold.
A held flag stops it from holding again right after the resume; it resets when the loop starts over.
Pauses the video and starts the 5 s wait.

nodes.label: Hold timer
nodes.desc: The pending resume while the video holds; set means the video is paused but still counts as playing.
nodes.store: useRef in useHeroVideo · lost on reload

nodes.label: Resume after 5 s
nodes.desc: Plays the video again when the hold is over.
logic: A setTimeout of INTRO_HOLD.seconds (5 s) starts when the hold begins.
When it fires it clears the timer and plays the video.
Leaving the page or switching language cancels it.

nodes.label: Play controls
nodes.desc: The round play/pause button and how it stays truthful during the intro hold and without media.

nodes.label: Toggle play
nodes.desc: Plays or pauses the video when the button is clicked.
logic: During the intro hold: cancel the resume and show Play; the video is already still.
Paused: play; if the browser refuses or the media is missing, show Play.
Playing: pause.

nodes.label: Track play state
nodes.desc: Keeps the button's icon in step with the video.
logic: A play event sets playing.
A pause event clears it, except while the hold timer is set: the hold is not the visitor's pause.

nodes.label: Playing
nodes.desc: Whether the button shows Pause (playing) or Play.
nodes.store: React state in useHeroVideo · lost on reload

nodes.label: No media loaded
nodes.desc: Handles a page without the video files, like a fresh checkout.
logic: Listens on the last <source> (the MP4): its error means no format loaded.
Marks the video as failed and not playing; the ink background and titles stay.

nodes.label: Media failed
nodes.desc: Set when no video format could load.
nodes.store: React state in useHeroVideo · lost on reload

nodes.label: Play / Pause button
nodes.desc: Shows ❚❚ with the label Pause while playing, ▶ Play otherwise; hidden when the media failed.

nodes.label: Hero title and subtitle
nodes.desc: The segment's title and subtitle in the page's language. Each new title fades in (450 ms CSS animation, off with reduced motion).

nodes.label: Navigation
nodes.desc: The menu, in-page links and how the page scrolls. Nothing on the page reacts to scrolling itself: no scroll listeners, no scroll-driven animation.

nodes.label: Click Menu / Escape
nodes.desc: The visitor opens or closes the menu sheet.

nodes.label: Open or close menu
nodes.desc: Flips the menu open or shut.
logic: The Menu button flips it; its label becomes Close.
While open, Escape closes it (a keydown listener lives only while the menu is open).
Any click inside the sheet, a link included, closes it.

nodes.label: Menu open
nodes.desc: Whether the menu sheet is showing.
nodes.store: React state in TopBar · lost on reload

nodes.label: Menu sheet
nodes.desc: Links to Features, Example, Install and GitHub.

nodes.label: Browser anchor scroll
nodes.desc: The browser scrolls to the section with that id. CSS makes it smooth (scroll-behavior: smooth) and instant for visitors who asked for reduced motion.

nodes.label: Section in view
nodes.desc: The section scrolls into view under the top bar, which stays put.

nodes.label: GitHub repository
nodes.desc: github.com/gabolondon/agentic-fbd, opened in the same tab (rel=noopener); the footer link goes to its LICENSE.

nodes.label: Install copy
nodes.desc: The two install commands and their Copy buttons.

nodes.label: Clipboard API
nodes.desc: navigator.clipboard.writeText; refused on plain http or when the browser denies it.

nodes.label: Show Copied
nodes.desc: Confirms the copy on the button for a moment.
logic: Sets copied, so the button reads Copied.
After 1.6 s it goes back to Copy.

nodes.label: Copied
nodes.desc: Whether this command's button says Copied; each command has its own.
nodes.store: React state in Command · lost on reload

nodes.label: Select the command
nodes.desc: Falls back to selecting the command so the visitor can copy it by hand.
logic: Builds a range over the <code> element.
Replaces the page selection with it.

nodes.label: Copied, or selected
nodes.desc: The command is on the clipboard with a Copied label, or selected on the page ready for Cmd/Ctrl+C.

nodes.label: Page text in EN or ES
nodes.desc: Every heading, paragraph, label and alt text in the current language, from en.json or es.json.

risks.title: Layout is chosen once per load
risks.detail: pick-layout reads the orientation only on the first render. Rotating a phone or tablet, or resizing a desktop window to portrait, keeps the first render: a tall video on a landscape screen or the other way round, cropped by object-fit: cover.
risks.resolution: Listen to the matchMedia change event and switch the layout (the video remounts, like a language switch).

risks.title: Switching language restarts the video
risks.detail: The <video> is keyed by language, so EN/ES mounts a new one at 0 s and the 5 s intro hold runs again. The title keeps the old segment until the new video's first timeupdate.
risks.resolution: Acceptable for a background loop; to keep the place, carry currentTime over to the new video.
